problem.paragraph: Explain in your own words what is meant by the equation
Is it possible for this statement to be true and yet $$f(2) = 3$$ ? Explain.
Explain what it means to say that
In this situation is it possible that $$\lim_{x\rightarrow 1}f(x)$$ exists? Explain.
Explain the meaning of each of the following.

solution.paragraph: $$\lim_{x\rightarrow - 3}f(x) = \infty$$ means that the values of $$f(x)$$ can be made arbitrarily large (as large as we please) by taking $$x$$ sufficiently close to $$- 3$$ (but not equal to $$- 3$$ ).
$$\lim_{x\rightarrow 4^{+}}f(x) = - \infty$$ means that the values of $$f(x)$$ can be made arbitrarily large negative by taking $$x$$ sufficiently close to $$4$$ through values larger than $$4$$ .
